name: Abu al-Qasim al-Azafi
note: became ruler 654 AH (1256/57); source gives no end date nor any ruler for 1291 (work list has Abu Hatim al-Azafi); Azafids later acknowledged Marinid sovereignty, rebelled 1304; city conquered by Granada May 1306, returned to the Marinids 1309

name: Yahya al-Azafi
note: made Marinid governor of Ceuta 1311; died between 1322 and 1328

name: Abu al-Qasim
note: son of Yahya; Marinid forces entered the city in 1327 or 1328, ending its autonomy (direct rule of Abu Sa'id Uthman II)
